steps.note: S1.1.1.1 states the net target change (JV+RG)x independent of the initial scratch contents a,c, supported by the quote 'Rows 6 and 7 restore c,a', and the S1.1.1 method says the old scratch effect is cancelled first and the scratch restored last.

S1.1.1.2 gives the bit-case central coefficient |S cap T| mod 2, side wires cancelling the unwanted neighbour cases, other intersection sizes zero and self coefficient one (it does not name 'intersection one' explicitly, but the quote at line 753 anchors the side-cancellation role).

S1.1.1.2 gives the complex-case central coefficient (|S cap T|-1)/2 with side wires cancelling the unwanted cases and self coefficient one, though the cancelled intersection sizes (zero and two) are not named.
S1.1.1.3 states the three stages (x,y)->(x,y+x)->(-y,y+x)->(-y,x) (forward, inverse, forward) restoring every auxiliary wire.
The plan never gives the per-edge orthogonal residuals or their dimensions (the residual table); S1.1.3.3 only says labels are nested/comparable on every edge and the single decreasing edge loses h.
S1.1.3.2 states only the inclusion P(x)<t_X> inside P(x)t_Y^perp from t_X perp t_Y; the complement <t_X,t_Y>^perp, its dimension h-2 and the edge 2->5 residual are not stated.
The plan states center 3->4 as the only decreasing edge losing h, source dimensions N, sink dimensions Wm-N, signed sum Wm-2N, and absolute sum Wm-2N+2L with Ic decreasing edges.

The plan uses 'orthonormal residual vector' in S2.1/S2.1.2 but never states that each nonzero residual is nondegenerate and nonalternating over F_2 or that this yields an orthonormal basis (alternating-plane absorption absent).

S2.1 method cites additivity of Hamming weight modulo 4 on orthogonal vectors as the reason the phase frames split, with one kernel per orthonormal residual vector, but the explicit sum q_V-q_U = sum wt(v)[v.x] is not written (borderline).

The plan asserts the kernel aI+bX (and aI+bX_v exponent epsilon_j) but never states that wt(v) is odd, the resulting phase i^{eps[v.x]}, or the identity H diag(1,-1) H = X that turns it into a translation.

S2.1.2 gives exactly one kernel per residual basis vector and S2.1.5 gives exactly s_c child calls each acting on the f columns/axes of one slot, matching one tensored factor per residual vector and s_c in all.

The plan has C^{-1}=-iZCZ and (C^{-1})^{(x)f} wrapper identities (S2.1.1, S2.1.3) but no endpoint frames (zero label I, full label C^{(x)m}), no 27-coordinate supp(u_a) inverse on X_a->Y_a, no Z_{a,k} / i^{27k}Z_{a,k} repair, and no negation of the X outputs.
The plan states both loss ratios are below 1/2, the deficit N-2L_b>0 and hence s_b<W_b m.
The value eta_c=73/19906842167500 (or any relative deficit for the complex network) appears nowhere in the plan.

S1.1.4.6 has the chain eta_b>20*2^-50 and m^{1-2^-50}>m(1-20*2^-50)>m(1-eta) giving s/W<m^tau, but omits the justification log m<20 and covers only the bit network (no complex deficit or sigma), so with doubt this is marked absent.

The plan states the elimination: topmost nonzero row's rightmost entry as pivot, clearing by lower-triangular column and row operations, deleting that row and column and repeating, so Pi has exactly a ones.
S1.1.5 never mentions the fixed odd prime avoiding denominators/numerators of a finite factor table or specialization of the rational identities to Z/q^b with invertible triangular factors.
S1.1.5.2 states a lower triangular transformation of H or D costs O(V) by updating coordinates in descending physical order.
S1.1.5.4 gives D_j<-D_j+H_i, an interchange of H_i,D_j, then D_j<-H_i-D_j for each one of Pi, one interchange each and a in all.
S2.4 uses Delta=ceil(C_0 d^{C_1}) and E in the recurrence, and S6.1.1 gives C_1=20, but E=64(W+m+1)^3, B=s+E, nu, C_1=max{20,nu+3} and C_0=128mB^2 are never defined.
S2.4.1 states A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E at an internal node and A(e)<=8e at a leaf (using s, not s/W), though the per-invocation count below E is not derived.
The plan has no unrolling of the recurrence (B^{k+1}<=B^2 d^nu, A(e)<=8B^2 d^{nu+1}, total below C_0 d^{C_1}); S2.4.4 just asserts Delta=o(p).
The plan states depth-ell values lie in 2^{-(p+ell)}Z[i] with modulus at most 2^ell, reserving p+Delta fractional and Delta+3 integer bits is exact, and epsilon*C_1<1 gives Delta=o(p).
S2.5 states every row of H_0^{(x)D} has absolute row sum one, so disk arrays are preserved and truncation errs by less than sqrt2*2^-p.

summary: P04 carries the bank-exchange network fully (B1-B4), the label-budget totals (L3, L5), the rank-saving ratio and eta_b (R1, R2), the matrix-shear factorization, cost and per-one interchange (M1, M3, M4), and the guard-bit recurrence, bit widths and row-sum disk preservation (S2, S4, S5), plus the weight-additivity/kernel-count steps (P1, P3). It omits the residual table (L1), the side-edge complement of dimension h-2 (L2), the F_2 orthonormal-basis existence (L4), the odd-weight/Hadamard derivation of the translation kernel (P2), the endpoint frames and 27-coordinate repair (P4), eta_c (R3), the log m<20 step and complex-network deficit (R4), the fixed prime (M2), the guard-bit constants (S1) and the unrolling (S3).
